title: OP-03 Pareto point (one per line in results/pareto.jsonl)
description: One measured operating point. Every point must be backed by a real run: the run_id has to appear in results/manifest.json and its spend in the gateway ledger. Projected points are not points.

run_id.description: Must match a run in results/manifest.json.

cost_per_resolved_case.description: Ledger cost divided by cases resolved. Deferred and failed cases are excluded from the denominator; their spend remains in the numerator: refusing to work must not look cheap.

deferral_rate.description: Overall handoff rate, including policy-required escalations. Reported separately from the elective-deferral bar.

what_changed.description: One line: what this point does differently from the one before it.

rejected.description: True for points you measured and did not choose. Include them — the shape of the curve is the finding.

elective_deferral_rate.description: Elective handoffs / automatable cases, excluding cases whose trusted goal requires escalation.
